segments.thig13.3:3.1: “Mā me kujjhi mahāvīra, mā me kujjhi mahāmuni;
segments.thig13.3:3.3: Na hi kodhaparetassa, suddhi atthi kuto tapo.
segments.thig13.3:5.1: “Ehi kāḷa nivattassu, bhuñja kāme yathā pure;
segments.thig13.3:5.3: Ahañca te vasīkatā, ye ca me santi ñātakā”.
segments.thig13.3:6.1: “Etto cāpe catubbhāgaṃ, yathā bhāsasi tvañca me;
segments.thig13.3:6.3: Tayi rattassa posassa, uḷāraṃ vata taṃ siyā”.
segments.thig13.3:8.3: Taṃ maṃ rūpavatiṃ santiṃ, kassa ohāya gacchasi”.
segments.thig13.3:9.3: Āharimena rūpena, na maṃ tvaṃ bādhayissasi”.
segments.thig13.3:10.3: Taṃ maṃ puttavatiṃ santiṃ, kassa ohāya gacchasi”.
segments.thig13.3:11.1: “Jahanti putte sappaññā, tato ñātī tato dhanaṃ;
segments.thig13.3:12.1: “Idāni te imaṃ puttaṃ, daṇḍena churikāya vā;
segments.thig13.3:12.3: Bhūmiyaṃ vā nisumbhissaṃ [nisumbheyyaṃ (sī.)], puttasokā na gacchasi”.
segments.thig13.3:14.1: “Handa kho dāni bhaddante, kuhiṃ kāḷa gamissasi;
segments.thig13.3:16.1: “Eso hi bhagavā buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati;
segments.thig13.3:16.5: Tassāhaṃ santikaṃ gacchaṃ, so me satthā bhavissati”.
segments.thig13.3:18.1: “Etaṃ kho labbhamamhehi, yathā bhāsasi tvañca me;
segments.thig13.3:18.3: Vandanaṃ dāni te vajjaṃ, lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ;
segments.thig13.3:19.1: Tato ca kāḷo pakkāmi, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati;
segments.thig13.3:19.3: So addasāsi sambuddhaṃ, desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ.
segments.thig13.3:21.1: Tassa pādāni vanditvā, katvāna naṃ [katvānahaṃ (sī.)] padakkhiṇaṃ;
segments.thig13.3:21.5: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.

lines: Cāpasadisaaṅgalaṭṭhitāya hi sā, cāpāti nāmaṃ labhi, tasmā, cāpāti vuccati.
Tvaṃ cāpe, yathā bhāsasi, idāni yādisaṃ kathesi, ito catubbhāga meva piyasamudācāraṃ kareyyāsi.
Tayi rattassa rāgābhibhūtassa purisassa uḷāraṃ vata taṃ siyā, ahaṃ panetarahi tayi kāmesu ca viratto, tasmā cāpāya vacane na tiṭṭhāmīti adhippāyo.
Puna, cāpā, attani tassa āsattiṃ uppādetukāmā “kāḷaṅginin”ti āha.
Takkāriṃ pupphitaṃ girimuddhanīti pabbatamuddhani ṭhitaṃ supupphitadālimalaṭṭhiṃ viya.
“Ukkāgārin”ti ca keci paṭhanti, aṅgatthilaṭṭhiṃ viyāti attho.
Girimuddhanīti ca idaṃ kenaci anupahatasobhatādassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ.
Keci “kāliṅginin”ti pāṭhaṃ vatvā tassa kumbhaṇḍalatāsadisanti atthaṃ vadanti.
Antodīpeva pāṭalinti dīpakabbhantare pupphitapāṭalirukkhaṃ viya, dīpaggahaṇañcettha sobhāpāṭihāriyadassanatthameva.
Kassa ohāya gacchasīti kassa nāma sattassa, kassa vā hetuno, kena kāraṇena, ohāya pahāya pariccajitvā gacchasi.
Ito parampi tesaṃ vacanapaṭivacanagāthāva ṭhapetvā pariyosāne tisso gāthā.
Āharimena rūpenāti kesamaṇḍanādinā sarīrajagganena ceva vatthābharaṇādinā ca abhisaṅkhārikena rūpena vaṇṇena kittimena cāturiyenāti attho.
Na maṃ tvaṃ bādhayissasīti pubbe viya idāni maṃ tvaṃ na bādhituṃ sakkhissasi.
Sappaññāti paññavanto, saṃsāre ādīnavavibhāviniyā paññāya samannāgatāti adhippāyo.
Te hi appaṃ vā mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ vā pahāya pabbajanti.
“pabbajanti mahāvīrā, nāgo chetvāva bandhanan”ti, ayabandhanaṃ viya hatthināgo gihibandhanaṃ chinditvā mahāvīriyāva pabbajanti, na nihīnavīriyāti attho.
Bhūmiyaṃ vā nisumbhissanti pathaviyaṃ pātetvā pothanavijjhanādinā vibādhissāmi.
Idāni tassa gamanaṃ anujānitvā gamanaṭṭhānaṃ jānituṃ “handa kho”ti gāthamāha.
Itaro pubbe ahaṃ aniyyānikaṃ sāsanaṃ paggayha aṭṭhāsiṃ, idāni pana niyyānike anantajinassa sāsane ṭhātukāmo, tasmā tassa santikaṃ gamissāmīti dassento “ahumhā”tiādimāha.
Nerañjaraṃ patīti nerañjarāya nadiyā samīpe tassā tīre.
Buddhoti abhisambodhiṃ patto, abhisambodhiṃ patvā dhammaṃ desento sabbakālaṃ bhagavā tattheva vasīti adhippāyena vadati.
Vandanaṃ dāni me vajjāsīti mama vandanaṃ vadeyyāsi, mama vacanena lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ vadeyyāsīti attho.

Padakkhiṇañca katvāna, ādiseyyāsi dakkhiṇanti buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvāpi catūsu ṭhānesu vanditvā, tato puññato mayhaṃ pattidānaṃ dento padakkhiṇaṃ ādiseyyāsi buddhaguṇānaṃ sutapubbattā hetusampannatāya ca evaṃ vadati.
Etaṃ kho labbhamamhehīti etaṃ padakkhiṇakaraṇaṃ puññaṃ amhehi tava dātuṃ sakkā, na nivattanaṃ, pubbe viya kāmūpabhogo ca na sakkāti adhippāyo.
